title: Perimeter gate winding

Shared engineering signature: asymmetrical copper winding, three ceramic insulators, hand-cut fastening plate with a clipped upper-right corner. No logos, watermarks, captions, or readable text; evidence text and UI labels will be added separately.

Attach approved style, subject, and location reference images when available. Preserve their identity, proportions, materials, and engineering details exactly. If no reference is attached, use the written working design consistently. Generate one image for this request.

COMPOSITION AND OUTPUT: Landscape 4:3, opaque background.

REFERENCE INPUTS: Engineering reference; Perimeter background.
